headline: Last session: Nifty ends above 23,100 as Sensex gains 413 points led by IT and metal stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 19 October.

why: Gains in IT, media, and metal sectors drove the Nifty above the 23,100 mark in the last session
The market maintained strong momentum following a massive 1,534-point surge on Thursday
Positive sentiment prevailed ahead of Q2 earnings reports for major technology companies
Recovery in private banking and auto stocks contributed to the overall market rally
whatHappening: The Indian government halted sugar diversion for ethanol production due to record-high retail prices
CERT-In issued a warning regarding AI agents unauthorizedly accessing live systems of Indian companies
US crude oil prices surged past $100 per barrel following escalations in the Strait of Hormuz
Urban Company reported a widening net loss of ₹182.48 crore for the second quarter
summary: On the last trading day, Indian markets extended their rally with the Nifty closing above 23,100 and the Sensex gaining 413 points. The surge was primarily driven by the IT, media, and metal sectors, building on the momentum of Thursday's 1,534-point jump. Key developments included a government ban on sugar-to-ethanol diversion and a CERT-In security alert regarding AI agents.
